verdict.rationale: Morph exposes a version-prefixed API base URL (`https://api.morphllm.com/v1`) and versioned model identifiers such as `morph-v3-fast`, so its API surface is versioned at a basic level. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, a changelog, or version-support guarantees, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation/sunset timelines and notice periods, API changelog or version-support guarantees, published versioned OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of version stability.
